title: Concept: Spring exception class printed in a response
description: Framework internals in a response shorten the attacker's reconnaissance: package names reveal the stack, and bean or channel names hint at the integration points worth probing.
applicability: Custom error controllers, default Whitelabel pages and API clients that pass through spring stack strings.
risk: The leak is informational on its own, but combined with a version fingerprint it points at the exact vulnerable component.
